name: mlflow load_model of untrusted run/registry artifact
attack_scenario: An attacker with write access to a staging model version replaces the pickled artifact; the next mlflow.pyfunc.load_model on that stage deserializes and runs the payload.
negative_test_hint: call load_model with "models:/attacker-controlled-model/Staging" and assert the artifact is refused unless it comes from a signed, vetted source

exemplar.explanation: mlflow.*.load_model reads the MLmodel spec and unpickles the flavor's artifact (often a pickle/cloudpickle), so an attacker-writable run or registry stage yields RCE on load. Restrict to signed, access-controlled artifacts.
